title: Rock And Stone!
description: This mod from i made in Mcreator. Mod add new keybind V name: Rock and Stone, when you press u will say Rock and Stone from game Deep rock galactic
body:
This mod from i made in _Mcreator_. Mod add _new keybind V_ name: Rock and Stone, when you press u will say **Rock and Stone** from game _Deep rock galactic! But u need pickaxe in mainhand_

For change keybind find in _Miscellaneous_.
